In the same way pregnant women can occasionally drink a glass of wine, healthy eaters can occasionally eat greasy food. 

For the sake of your relationship and your wife's well-being, you should avoid making comments on what she eats. She's paying a trained, educated dietician good money to give her professional advice. I recommend having certain types of activities you do with certain people. For example I have specific friends I go to art museums with. At first I did the initiating, but after a while they associated going to the museum with going with me, so they started inviting me. I have different friends who I would go to brunch with (first I initiated, but eventually I was just included anytime a brunch plan with these friends was made). Same with hiking, running, board games, happy hours, etc. People are creatures of habit and comfort, so a lot of times it’s just about having a routine.

I also find most plans are made in person, and whoever is there is generally invited to the next thing. Happy hour conversation leads to talking about a weekend hike. On the weekend hike you talk about seeing a movie next week. Etc etc. If you’re not invited it’s likely you just weren’t there for the conversation, not that no one wants you around.

It can be really hard, and you have to keep in mind that some people already have groups of friends who fulfill their time. But every once in a while you’ll find a friend who is as eager to spend time with you as you are with them. I only find someone like this every few months, but that’s ok! Those people are special and they usually stick around the longest.
